two main objectives: (i) automatically discovering complex concepts from natural language and (ii) using these concepts as a bottleneck for video classification, which enables reasoning and intervention about high-level visual concepts.

complex concepts can be automatically discovered from natural language, and can be used to explain and intervene in the video classification task.
